facts.text: The product is Duropedic Airboost 6.8 Arctic Ice Mattress | 1 lakh+ Airknit fibres with latex and adjustable firmness | 100 nights trial.
Selected variant: Queen / 78 x 60 (198 cm x 152 cm) / 8 (20.3 cm).
The product title identifies Airknit fibres with latex.

Airboost is described as Duroflex's proprietary open-matrix mattress technology, made from over one lakh independently responsive fibres and designed to improve airflow, movement response and postural support.
The mattress features a 6-inch Airboost layer combined with latex.
The mattress features a reversible latex topper with firm support on one side and medium-firm support on the other.
Flipping the mattress switches between the two firmness levels.
The zipper cover makes it easy to remove and identify each side.
The zipper cover is machine washable; softer wash settings should be used to increase durability.
The product title states a 100-nights trial.
The FAQ states that this Airboost mattress comes with a 100-day sleep trial period.
The page displays a 10-years warranty claim.
Airboost mattress warranty duration is stated as varying from 7–10 years depending on the variant; the duration for this selected variant is not established.
The page states that Airboost mattresses have a long-term manufacturer warranty covering manufacturing defects and material issues under normal use conditions.

NHA Accreditation Exclusively approved by doctors at NHA
